sources.supports: Official solicitation gives the last-Monday-in-September and last-Monday-in-January annual target dates; proposals accepted anytime; RES, EDU, and SEED caps and durations; $60m/year anticipated funding; eligible proposer types, PI appointments, and per-person proposal limits.

sources.program: NSF National Artificial Intelligence Research Institutes
sources.supports: NSF page says status is waiting for new publication, there are no upcoming due dates, and Program 23-610 is waiting. Describes prior themes; no current-cycle amount or application terms are advertised.

NSF program page describes foundational robotics scope and three responsiveness criteria; full proposals accepted anytime after August 1, 2020. Page encourages discussion with a program officer and links general NSF proposal guidelines.

sources.program: NSF Future CoRe / Software and Hardware Foundations (NSF 25-543)
sources.supports: Current solicitation places SHF within Future CoRe, accepts proposals anytime, gives annual first-Thursday-in-February and second-Thursday-in-September target rules, and replaces small/medium classes with one class capped at $1m over 4 years; typical funding is $150k–$250k/year.

sources.program: NSF Future CoRe — Algorithmic Foundations and CPS
sources.supports: Current NSF page lists AF and CPS as Future CoRe programs, 2027 target dates February 4 and September 9, anytime submission, shared budget cap up to $1m/four years, and a two-proposal-per-person limit.

sources.program: NSF Pathways to Enable Secure Open-Source Ecosystems (PESOSE), NSF 26-506
sources.supports: Current solicitation gives annual September and March deadlines, award caps for Tracks 1–3, anticipated funding, program scope, I-Corps requirements, and lead organization/subaward constraints.

sources.program: NSF Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF 23-601
sources.supports: NSF program page gives the August 18, 2027 annual third-Wednesday deadline, describes Sites and Supplements, confirms U.S. citizenship/national/permanent-resident eligibility for student participants, and estimates annual award counts.
